I am Dr. Agent. You've presented with fatigue, unintentional weight loss, and abnormal physical exam findings. To narrow this down efficiently, please describe any specific lumps, swelling, or changes you've noticed on your body.

REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: WBC: 16,000 /μL (elevated), Hemoglobin: 11 g/dL (low), Platelets: Normal

speaker: Doctor
text:
The blood work shows you have a high white blood cell count, low hemoglobin, and normal platelets, which suggests bone marrow overproduction or infiltration. Given your weight loss and fatigue, could you describe the specific abnormal findings from your physical exam, such as enlarged lymph nodes, an enlarged spleen, or skin changes?

REQUEST TEST: Lactate_Dehydrogenase (LDH)
REQUEST TEST: Peripheral_Blood_Smear

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Lactate Dehydrogenase: NORMAL READINGS; Peripheral_Blood_Smear: Increased lymphocytes with smudge cells

speaker: Doctor
text:
The peripheral blood smear showing increased lymphocytes with smudge cells is highly characteristic of Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia (CLL), supported by your elevated white blood cell count and lymphocytosis. Does this align with your history of fatigue and weight loss, and have you noticed any recurrent infections or night sweats?

DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia
